# Invented learning gardens review protocol

## Research question
What do the supplied invented learning-garden records state about changes in recall?

## Scope and inclusion criteria
Include every record supplied in input.json, preserving both supplied claim/source pairs and the synthesis wording exactly. These are entirely invented records for deterministic integrity evaluation, not real scientific evidence. No population, date, language, or method filters beyond membership in the supplied fixture apply.

## Exclusion criteria
Exclude records outside the supplied fixture. Do not supplement the records with external literature or invented metadata.

## Authorization and workflow
The user authorized complete workspace creation in the current directory with no scope checkpoint. The public fixture was copied unchanged to input.json because no input.json was present. User instructions take precedence over the skill's default workspace subdirectory and verification workflow.

## Integrity preservation
